summary: Marc Andreessen co-created the Mosaic web browser, co-founded Netscape, Loudcloud/Opsware and, in 2009, the venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz with Ben Horowitz. With Horowitz he published the firm's "Little Tech Agenda" in July 2024 and endorsed Donald Trump; he then helped recruit staff for the Trump transition and DOGE, and Trump named him to PCAST in March 2026. He and Horowitz are among the largest funders of pro-AI and pro-crypto super PACs in the 2026 midterms.
